title: Prove sharp critical-tail parity-cut bound N (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. For every dyadic dimension N, the exact triangular Toeplitz parity compiler has the sharp common infinity-norm envelope N for every prefix, suffix, inverse prefix and inverse suffix when the coefficient tail has l1 norm at most one. This includes arbitrary legal child interleavings and endpoint cuts.

```text
T_N(f) = Q P,   sum_(j>=1) |f_j| <= 1
max(||P||, ||P^-1||, ||Q||, ||Q^-1||) <= N
f = 1-z attains N at its inverse endpoint
```

The existing four-cut envelope 1/(1-eta) applies at eta<1. The new result covers the critical boundary with a finite dimension-dependent bound. The proof retains the child tail budget, handles a=1,b=0 without dividing by zero, and uses finite nilpotent inversion. The existing forward-prefix bound 1+eta and binomial suffix law are credited context, not replay deliverables or new claims.

Credit Vlado Vojdanovski / PR1673, Cinna Davis / PR4100, James Reed / PR4699, Brian / PR4731 and PR4737, Nick Petalas / PR4831, Ryanson Jonathan and the retained Gaussian/compiler lineage. The new proof and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362993).

## Evidence

Before: the strict-tail four-cut bound diverges at eta=1, while separate forward and binomial-family results leave the common critical-class envelope unspecified. After: PROOF.md gives the sharp N theorem for the complete real/complex tail ball and every legal macro schedule.

Local warning-strict normal and optimized replays pass. Each registered command was timed locally at approximately 0.74s and 0.72s, below its 60-second limit. The exact finite evidence has 162 rational symbols, 91 critical symbols, 951 cut quadruples, 557 nonleaf tree nodes, six attaining dimensions through 32 and seven controls. A dense row-elimination inverse independently checks literal cut matrices. These counts describe the newly enumerated fixtures, not predecessor coverage or all complex symbols.

Both registered commands, metadata/source pins, six-file committed-byte and source-history checks, AST/in-memory compilation, function-size and whitespace checks pass. A read-only Git-free optimized export replay passes with unchanged bytes and the same receipt. The verifier imports no predecessor executable and writes no files. Its generated receipt binds the six package files; no receipt is handwritten or committed.

From the worktree root, using standard-library CPython 3.12:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/critical-tail-parity-cuts/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/critical-tail-parity-cuts/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/critical-tail-parity-cuts
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/critical-tail-parity-cuts --check-source-history
```

The direct marker is PASS_CRITICAL_TAIL_PARITY_CUTS. Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the local absolute path. Scientific base is canonical main 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. The formal-interface card is explicitly changed to a written component theorem without proof-kernel formalization or selected-caller discharge. Canonical main and guidance were unchanged at the submission refresh.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Complete-shear boundaries only. No cut inside the physical shear implementation is covered. The theorem does not install new precision or admit critical tails to the strict Gaussian caller. Internal amplification, extra rounding events, preparation, native realization, owned storage/restoration, movement, tapes, stock, compiler, recursive invoices and outer recovery remain unpriced. All five selected framework assumptions retain their status. No new kappa, selected-frontier change, supplier admission, complete multiplication theorem, independent human review or formal proof-kernel review is claimed. Selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were unrun.

## Open next questions

1. Determine the sharp universal forward-suffix-only bound at the critical tail. Start with a suffix induction on independent even/odd budgets; the common N bound is forced by inverse endpoints, while the credited binomial family needs only 1+log2(N).
2. Bind one actual critical-tail shear microprogram to its full rounding, amplification and tape bill. That physical implementation and its complete cost remain missing.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this critical-tail parity macro-cut envelope was found in the original 412-body open-PR snapshot or the completion refresh. The completion refresh inspected this account's six other open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-11-03T00:08:15Z: #6465, #6466, #6467, #6468, #6469 and #6471. They study frozen-snapshot channels, observable-mask preparation, an elementary matcher route, cyclic balancing, a characteristic-five replay and compatible-flag fitting rank. None computes the critical-tail parity-cut envelope. No extra computation checked another contribution or compared a new common-instance number. Relevant all-main compiler notes and merged general-form searches were checked separately; unpublished work and later posts remain outside coverage.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Six new files under research/critical-tail-parity-cuts; shared code, frozen evidence and the selected record are unchanged.
